entries.title: Release asset upload lacks write permission
entries.root_cause: The release job's GITHUB_TOKEN has contents read permission, so the GitHub API rejects the release asset upload. Grant the job contents write permission.

entries.title: Release asset upload denied
entries.root_cause: The release job's GITHUB_TOKEN has contents read permission, so the GitHub API rejects the release asset upload. Grant the job contents write permission.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A different tag and runner reach the same upload denial; a subsequent verification step fails to download the absent asset and supplies the final error.

entries.title: Go build references an undefined function
entries.root_cause: The release command calls a nonexistent function in the internal soundings package. Correct the function reference before building.

entries.title: Release upload rejected by API
entries.root_cause: The release job's GITHUB_TOKEN has contents read permission, so the GitHub API rejects the release asset upload. Grant the job contents write permission.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later tag builds a different target and invokes gh release upload with a tag variable, but the API again rejects the read-only token.
